fields.name: responsible_charge_defined
fields.description: Whether the statute explicitly defines 'responsible charge' as a standard of competence and accountability for independent practice.
fields.sample_quote: 'Responsible charge' means such degree of competence and accountability gained by technical education or experience of a grade and character as is sufficient to qualify a person to personally and independently engage in and be entrusted with the work involved in the practice of landscape architecture.

fields.name: experience_pathways
fields.category: education and experience pathways to licensure
fields.description: Alternative combinations of education and practical experience accepted in lieu of a single standard pathway to sit for the licensing exam.
fields.sample_quote: in lieu of graduation from an approved college or school of landscape architecture and the practical experience in addition thereto, an applicant may be admitted to the examination upon presenting evidence of at least eight years of actual, practical experience in landscape architectural work

fields.name: clарb_exam_recognized
fields.description: Whether the state recognizes or requires the C.L.A.R.B. Uniform National Examination as the licensing exam.
fields.sample_quote: Cause to be administered, the C.L.A.R.B. Uniform National Examination, or such other examination, as may be approved by the board at least once each year

fields.name: clarb_reciprocity_exam_waiver
fields.description: Whether an applicant holding a license from another state that administered the C.L.A.R.B. Uniform Examination may be exempted from re-examination.
fields.sample_quote: To exempt from examination an applicant who holds a license or certificate to practice landscape architecture issued to him by another state which maintains a system and standards of qualifications and administers the C.L.A.R.B. Uniform Examination.

fields.name: seal_required
fields.description: Whether licensed landscape architects are required to obtain and use an official seal on plans, specifications, and reports.
fields.sample_quote: Each person registered under this act shall obtain a seal of a design authorized by the board, which shall bear the registrant's name and number and the legend 'Registered Landscape Architect.' The seal or a facsimile imprint of same shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plates and reports issued by a landscape architect.

fields.name: seal_legend_text
fields.description: The required text or legend that must appear on the official professional seal.
fields.sample_quote: which shall bear the registrant's name and number and the legend 'Registered Landscape Architect'

fields.name: scope_exclusions
fields.category: what they can and cannot do
fields.description: Activities or services explicitly excluded from the authorized scope of landscape architecture practice.
fields.sample_quote: shall not include the design of structures or facilities as are ordinarily included in the practice of engineering or architecture and shall not include the making of land surveys

fields.name: exempted_occupations
fields.category: who is exempt from needing a license
fields.description: Occupations or categories of persons explicitly exempted from the licensure requirement.
fields.sample_quote: The practice of any nurseryman, landscape nurseryman, gardener or landscape gardener, general or landscape contractor as that practice pertains to planting design and its incidental items.

fields.name: nonresident_temporary_practice_days
fields.category: who is exempt from needing a license
fields.description: Maximum number of days per calendar year a nonresident licensee from another qualifying state may practice without obtaining a local license.
fields.sample_quote: The practice of landscape architecture not exceeding thirty days in the aggregate in one calendar year by a nonresident not having a place of business in this Commonwealth if the person is legally qualified to engage in the practice of landscape architecture in the state or territory of his residence

fields.name: supervised_employee_exemption
fields.category: who is exempt from needing a license
fields.description: Whether employees or persons working under the supervision of a licensed landscape architect who do not assume responsible charge are exempt from licensure.
fields.sample_quote: The practice of landscape architecture by any person who acts under the supervision of a registered landscape architect or by an employe of a person lawfully engaged in the practice of landscape architecture and who in either event does not assume responsible charge of design or supervision

fields.name: continuing_education_waiver_conditions
fields.description: Conditions under which the board may waive continuing education requirements for a licensee.
fields.sample_quote: The board may waive all or part of the continuing education requirement for a landscape architect who shows evidence, to the board's satisfaction, that he was unable to complete the requirements due to illness, emergency or hardship.

fields.name: continuing_education_excluded_topics
fields.description: Topics or course types explicitly excluded from counting toward continuing education credit.
fields.sample_quote: No credit shall be given for any course in office management.

fields.name: inactive_license_ce_requirement
fields.description: Whether a licensee reactivating an inactive license must document completion of continuing education hours before reactivation.
fields.sample_quote: A licensed landscape architect who wishes to activate a license which has been placed on inactive status shall be required to document twenty-four hours of continuing education.

fields.name: title_protection_terms
fields.category: protected titles and unauthorized practice penalties
fields.description: Specific titles or terms whose use is restricted to licensed practitioners under the statute.
fields.sample_quote: It shall be unlawful for a person to practice landscape architecture or to use the term or title 'landscape architect' unless duly licensed under the provisions of this act.

fields.name: unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty
fields.category: protected titles and unauthorized practice penalties
fields.description: Criminal classification and maximum sentence for practicing without a license or misusing the protected title.
fields.sample_quote: shall be guilty of a summary offense and upon conviction thereof, shall be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding three hundred dollars ($300) or undergo imprisonment not exceeding ninety days, or both

fields.name: civil_penalty_maximum
fields.category: protected titles and unauthorized practice penalties
fields.description: Maximum civil monetary penalty (in dollars) the board may levy on a licensee or unlicensed practitioner for violations.
fields.sample_quote: may levy a civil penalty of up to one thousand dollars ($1,000) on any current licensee who violates any provision of this act or on any person who practices landscape architecture without being properly licensed
